📈 LinkedIn Audience Growth — Niche Strategy, Measurable Results

2,462 followers  ·  41,359 impressions

90 days. May – July 2026. Zero paid promotion. Highly targeted niche.

Started with 100+ legacy corporate connections and a blank content slate. In May 2026, built a deliberate LinkedIn presence around a specific niche — UHNW estate recruitment — creating content that spoke directly to private service and hospitality professionals: estate managers, directors of residences, chief of operations, and other decision-makers in the ultra-high-net-worth space.

By end of July: 2,413 new followers gained, 41,359 total impressions — +2,698% follower growth, +1,754% content reach. No ads, no shortcuts. Just a clear target audience and consistent, credibility-building content.

The same niche-first approach applies to your brand.

ANZ Bank · 9 Years · AU · NZ · IN · PH

I've already operated at the scale you're building toward

For nine years I ran administrative operations across four countries simultaneously — different timezones, different regulations, different teams, one standard of quality. I managed 10,000+ cases, conducted 200+ audits, and reduced response times by 30% not by working harder but by designing systems that didn't allow for slowness.

The instinct I developed there — find the gap before it costs someone — is the same one that caught a stalled compliance vendor in 2026 before my client even knew there was a problem. What looks like attention to detail is actually years of training myself to see around corners.

Global BPO · Customer Operations

High volume, no margin for error

A decade in BPO means you learn to perform under conditions most office environments never see — hundreds of interactions a week, real-time escalations, KPIs that don't forgive bad days. I moved across customer service, technical support, and sales not because I was rotated, but because I consistently hit the bar in each function and was pulled into the next challenge.

The skill that transferred to everything else: staying calm, staying accurate, and never letting urgency become an excuse for sloppiness.
